title: Detection of biomagnetic signals from induced pluripotent stem cell-derived cardiomyocytes using deep learning with simulation data.
summary: Deep learning trained with simulated and measured noise enabled detection of weak biomagnetic signals in measured mouse iPSC-cardiomyocyte samples; peak counts aligned with microscopy, supporting a specific non-invasive assay result. This is a cell-model feasibility study, not patient diagnosis.
